in_marathi.name: Nilay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nilay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'nilam', meaning 'blue'. In Hindu mythology, Nilam is a gemstone associated with the deity Krishna. It represents love, devotion, and purity.
